description: This file contains classes and methods for consuming Kafka data within Spark SQL Kafka connector, including Kafka consumer management, data fetching, offset handling, and resource management.

classes.name: InternalKafkaConsumer
classes.description: Manages a Kafka consumer for a specific partition, providing polling, fetching, and offset management.

classes.name: FetchedData
classes.description: Stores pre-fetched Kafka records and related offset information.

classes.name: FetchedRecord
classes.description: Represents a fetched Kafka record and the next offset to fetch.

classes.name: KafkaDataConsumerIterator
classes.description: Trait for iterating over Kafka records with timeout support.

classes.name: KafkaDataConsumer
classes.description: Handles reading data from Kafka, managing consumer pool, fetched data, and data loss detection.

classes.name: AvailableOffsetRange
classes.description: Represents the earliest and latest available offsets in Kafka.

classes.name: CacheKey
classes.description: Key for caching Kafka consumers and fetched data based on group ID and topic partition.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Polls Kafka for records within a specified timeout.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches records starting from a specific offset, returning records and offset after poll.

methods.name: getAvailableOffsetRange
methods.description: Returns the range of available offsets for the partition.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates a new KafkaConsumer instance with security configs.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks the consumer to a specific offset.
